name: veterinary_clinic_system_029_owner_payment_plan_split
instruction: The owner with the single largest unpaid overdue invoice asks to split it into two equal payments. Find that invoice (status 'overdue' or 'sent' past due; if tied on amount, pick the lower invoice number). Then: (1) mark the original invoice status 'split' and add field split_into='<batch_code>-A,<batch_code>-B'; (2) create two new invoices numbered 'INV-S<batch_code>-A' and 'INV-S<batch_code>-B', each with the same owner/patient/location as the original, line_items=[{description: 'Payment plan part A of INV-<original number>' (or part B), quantity: 1, unit_price: <half the original unpaid balance — round A DOWN to whole cents and give B the remainder so A+B equals the original exactly>}], total_amount equal to that part's unit_price, amount_paid 0, status 'sent', issued_date = episode date, due_date = episode date + 14 days for A and + 28 days for B. The owner's balance stays exactly as it was.

success_criteria.summary: Identify target from snapshot (max unpaid among overdue or sent-with-due<ep; tie -> lower number). Assert original status 'split' + exact split_into; exactly two new invoices with exact numbers/amounts (A=floor(half), B=remainder; cents exact), dp(due_date) == ep+14 / ep+28; owner balance unchanged (cents vs snapshot); invoice count 28.

checks.expect: Identify target from snapshot (max unpaid among overdue or sent-with-due<ep; tie -> lower number). Assert original status 'split' + exact split_into; exactly two new invoices with exact numbers/amount
